words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: to dictate, to read out (for someone to write down or dial)

examples.trans: The teacher is dictating a text.
Don't laugh. Read me the number.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Генерал Круглов ждёт звонка. Будьте любезны.
examples.trans: General Kruglov is waiting for a call. If you'd be so kind.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.
All right, here you go. There, look.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

examples.text: Наверное, что-то серьёзное у вас. Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: It must be something serious for you. The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Я тебе оставляю пять миллионов и условный срок.
examples.trans: I'll leave you five million and a suspended sentence.
There they officially confirmed this information.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.
She had a right to the flat.

examples.text: Моя мама имела право на квартиру. Она пенсионерка.
examples.trans: My mother had a right to the flat. She is a pensioner.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

examples.text: Как странно, я ничего об этом не слышал.
examples.trans: How strange, I've heard nothing about it.
This is not for a telephone conversation.

examples.text: Извини, но эта новость совсем не для телефонного разговора.
examples.trans: Sorry, but this news is not at all for a telephone conversation.

examples.text: Запиши мой новый телефонный номер на всякий случай.
examples.trans: Write down my new telephone number just in case.

увидеться.gloss: to see each other, meet up

examples.text: Послушай, мы сегодня увидимся вечером с тобой?
examples.trans: Listen, will we see each other this evening?
All right, see you in the kitchen, administrator!
I'll find out where he is.
You recognised me. Thanks for seeing me.
The restaurant owner personally greets the guests.
The owner is busy in the kitchen for now.

examples.text: Вовсе нет, я жду хозяина ресторана.
examples.trans: Not at all, I am waiting for the restaurant owner.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
